title: Myrtle Homewater
description: A descending melody finds its way through a returning bass, a bright chordal answer and two unhurried five-note flourishes. When the bass takes up the tune, the treble becomes a quiet shelter. The closing phrase leaves an added ninth in place above D.
technical_note: Give the dotted lower figure a supple, even touch. Two explicitly notated quintuplets spread five eighths over two quarter beats. At bar 19 the melody moves below: keep the upper dyads quiet. The final added ninth is sustained without an automatic fermata.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and independent note lengths; no random timing offsets.
